profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, trading under the ticker AI, with SEC CIK 0001577526. The website listed for the company is airliquide.com, and the text harvested from that site describes Air Liquide, a gases, technologies and services business for industry and healthcare, not C3.ai. By that text, Air Liquide describes itself as serving 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees, with revenues close to 27 billion euros in 2025, and as having innovated since 1902. The same text warns of fraudulent offers of Air Liquide shares and states that such offers do not come from the company.

No AI products are listed for C3.ai, and no MCP servers or litigation cases are recorded for it. The record does show law exposure in California, with a count of 237.

Because the harvested site content belongs to Air Liquide rather than to C3.ai, the material available here does not describe C3.ai's own products or its position in AI.
